verdict.rationale: Gladia is a speech-to-text API platform, and a SaaS product of this kind could plausibly ship an in-dashboard AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The LLM audio-intelligence features, MCP server and CLI are adjacent capabilities, not an in-product agentic assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
